name: @aimark/cli
description: The aimark CLI (Go) wrapped as an nx project

scripts.lint: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && golangci-lint run && bun run codegen:check
scripts.format: gofmt -w . && golangci-lint run && bun run codegen:check
scripts.codegen: go run github.com/atombender/go-jsonschema@v0.18.0 -p schema --only-models --output internal/schema/schema_gen.go ../../packages/schema/schemas/run.v1.json ../../packages/schema/schemas/suite-manifest.v1.json ../../packages/schema/schemas/samples.v1.json && gofmt -w internal/schema/schema_gen.go
scripts.codegen:check: bun run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- internal/schema || (echo 'Generated Go types are stale. Run `mise run codegen` and commit.' && exit 1)
